meta.name: docx-review
meta.description: Read, edit, and diff Word documents (.docx) with tracked changes and comments using the docx-review CLI — a .NET 8 tool built on Microsoft's Open XML SDK. Ships as a single 12MB native binary (no runtime). Use when: (1) Adding tracked changes (replace, delete, insert) to a .docx, (2) Adding anchored comments to a .docx, (3) Reading/extracting text, tracked changes, comments, and metadata from a .docx, (4) Diffing two .docx files semantically, (5) Responding to peer reviewer comments with tracked revisions, (6) Proofreading or revising manuscripts with reviewable output, (7) Any task requiring valid tracked-change .docx output with proper w:del/w:ins markup that renders natively in Word.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审阅和对比 Word 文档的修订与批注
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理带修订和批注的 Word 文档
copy.tagline_en: Review and diff Word documents with tracked changes and comments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with Word documents containing tracked changes and comments

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以读取、编辑和比较 Word 文档（.docx），包括添加修订和批注，并输出带有标准修订标记的文档。
howto.when: 当你需要给 Word 文档添加修订或批注、比较两个文档的差异、或提取文档内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这篇论文添加修订：把“结果”改成“结论”。
say.note: Claude 会生成修订并应用到文档。

say.text: 比较这两个 Word 文档的差异。
say.note: Claude 会输出语义对比结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read, edit, and compare Word documents (.docx), including adding tracked changes and comments, and output documents with proper revision markup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add tracked changes or comments to a .docx, compare two documents, or extract document content.

say_en.text: Add a tracked change to this paper: replace 'results' with 'conclusions'.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the revision and apply it.

say_en.text: Compare these two Word documents for differences.
say_en.note: Claude will output a semantic diff.
